tools.name: code_maintainability-index
tools.description: Build a structural AST from a caller-supplied JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Go snippet, or from a caller-supplied AST, and score cyclomatic complexity, cognitive load, nesting depth, and duplicated function structure. The snippet is not executed or stored. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/code/ma

tools.name: code_change-coupling-analyze
tools.description: Identify files outside a proposed change set that are coupled through supplied module edges, import paths, or historical co-change sets. The source is not compiled or executed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/code/change-coupling-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run

tools.name: code_concurrency-hazard-detect
tools.description: Flag potential race and shared-state hazards in caller-supplied source using deterministic pattern matches for async/concurrency markers, shared globals, and TOCTOU-shaped spans. The code is not executed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/code/concurrency-hazard-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402

tools.name: code_error-propagation-audit
tools.description: Find empty catches, swallowed promise rejections, logged-without-rethrow spans, and throw sites without local handlers in caller-supplied source. Pattern matches only; the code is not compiled or run. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/code/error-propagation-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 paymen

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "code" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: code_maintainability-index · Private data: code_change-coupling-analyze · Public sink: code_maintainability-index, code_change-coupling-analyze, code_concurrency-hazard-detect, code_error-propagation-audit · Destructive: code_maintainability-index, code_change-coupling-analyze, code_concurrency-hazard-detect, code_error-propagation-audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: code_maintainability-index · Private data: code_change-coupling-analyze · Public sink: code_maintainability-index, code_change-coupling-analyze, code_concurrency-hazard-detect, code_error-propagation-audit · Destructive: code_maintainability-index, code_change-coupling-analyze, code_concurrency-hazard-detect, code_error-propagation-audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
